newsitem.title: DUBAI: SIA, Lufthansa increase cargo cooperation.
newsitem.headline: SIA, Lufthansa increase cargo cooperation.

text.p: Singapore Airlines said it had expanded cargo co-operation with Germany's Lufthansa on Thursday by launching freight services between Frankfurt and Singapore via Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates.
Singapore Airlines (SIA) said in a statement issued in Dubai that the move increased the number of joint freighter services between Frankfurt and Singapore to four from two per week.
Freighter capacity on the four flights will be 400 tonnes per week in each direction.

"From 31 October 1996, two additional B747 freighter services will be launched each Thursday and Friday. On each of these days, SIA will operate from Singapore to Sharjah, while Lufthansa Cargo will operate between Frankfurt and Sharjah," the statement said.
From December 3, a SIA cargo flight from Singapore to Frankfurt currently flying via Dubai on Tuesdays will re-route to fly via Sharjah on the same day.
Lufthansa's current cargo flight on Mondays linking Singapore and Frankfurt will remain unchanged.
Sharjah is the 78th destination on SIA's route network.
